description: This file defines Pydantic models for handling responses related to analytics endpoints in Step 04 of the application. It includes models for summary metrics, anomaly detection, timeseries datasets, and their responses, with references to external SessionInfo and models.

classes.name: SummaryMetricsResponse
classes.description: Model representing summary metrics response for dashboard KPIs.

classes.name: AnomalyItem
classes.description: Model representing individual anomaly data points for alert display.

classes.name: AnomalyDetectionResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response for anomaly detection, including detected anomalies.

classes.name: TimeseriesDataset
classes.description: Model representing a dataset for timeseries charts.

classes.name: TimeseriesResponse
classes.description: Model representing a timeseries data response suitable for Chart.js.
